meta.unit: W40 (derivation half of the apply step)
meta.inputs: the committed export (corpus/) + a sqlite3.backup() snapshot of db/corpus.sqlite; read-only
meta.what: Mechanically derived `en` for the required-scope locale gaps (design/i18n.md scope table). Every row targets one export locale object that has pt-BR and no en today. Apply = write a localized_text row (db.entity_type, db.entity_id, db.field, 'en', layer 'B') for rows with `db`, or patch the builder literal for rows with `needs_plumbing` and db=null (kana).
meta.row_shape: {entity, id, field, locator, db, pt, en, layer, source, rule, confidence}

rules.tm-lemma: token gloss / conjugation_note: the en already in the index for the identical pt-BR string on the same lemma. Unanimous n>=2 high; n=1 or >=80% majority (n>=3) medium; anything else is ambiguous -> residue.
rules.tm-pos: token role: same, keyed by (neutral pos, pt-BR).
rules.tm-particle: particle function: keyed by (particle, function_type, pt-BR); particle explanation: keyed by (particle, pt-BR).
rules.tm-pt: fallback when the context key has no precedent: the bare pt-BR string; capped at medium.
rules.jmdict-sense-join: token gloss whose pt-BR is exactly the '; '-join of one vocab sense's pt-BR glosses (the W13b 'registry' origin): en = '; '-join of that JMdict sense's first three English glosses — the Layer-A text the pt-BR was translated from. Field en_layer stays B (a per-token gloss is Layer B by definition).
rules.jmdict-sense-element: token gloss equal to ONE pt-BR gloss of exactly one sense of the linked vocab: en = that sense's first three JMdict glosses. Medium: the first three can miss the element's own meaning.
rules.kana-family-template: 'Família do X' (build_kana.py template over the neutral row) -> 'X family'.
rules.kana-label-identity: 'っ (Sokuon)' has no Portuguese in it; en = the same string.

meta.backtest_note: each rule re-run on every instance that already has en, with that instance's own en removed from the memory; exact = identical string, overlap = shares a ;/,-separated item. JMdict rules score low on exact because the existing en is a translation of the pt-BR, not of JMdict — see the report §3.
